sloka: धृष्टं भवन्तो युध्यन्तु हरीणां मोहनाय वै।अहं तु रथमास्थाय आगमिष्यामि संयुगम् ।। ६.९१.६ ।।
transliteration: dhṛṣṭaṁ bhavanto yudhyantu harīṇāṁ mohanāya vai।ahaṁ tu rathamāsthāya āgamiṣyāmi saṁyugam ।। 6.91.6 ।।

translations.english: "You delude the sight of Vanaras in battle. I will come to the battle taking the chariot."
